agronomic_rationale: Widely practised status quo leveraging familiar maize inputs and traders across Ashanti.
key_risks: Declining soil N/organic matter; high vulnerability to minor-season cessation and fall armyworm carryover.
required_local_checks: Verify household fertilizer budget and Striga/armyworm incidence on plot.
source_citation: MoFA Ghana Agriculture Facts & Figures; CSIR-CRI Transition Zone Surveys

agronomic_rationale: 7-dekad cowpea matches Sep-Nov rainfall tail while fixing ~45 kg N/ha and breaking cereal pest cycles.
key_risks: Pod-sucking bugs and aphids in humid October weeks; price swings at Ejura assembly markets.
required_local_checks: Confirm certified Asontem/Soronko seed availability and storage bags with MoFA extension officer.
source_citation: CSIR-CRI Maize-Legume Sequence Guide; N2Africa Ashanti Trials

rotation_sequence: Major Maize + Mucuna Relay / Mulch Phase
agronomic_rationale: Dense Mucuna biomass covers sloping sandy clay loam through Harmattan Dec-Feb bare-soil risk dekads.
key_risks: Gives up minor-season cash harvest on relayed area; dry mulch can catch Harmattan bushfires.
required_local_checks: Confirm community firebreak rules and free-range grazing bylaws before relay sowing.
source_citation: IITA Forest-Transition Cover Crop Trials; CSIR-CRI Soil Conservation Bulletin

agronomic_rationale: Omankwa/Abontem maize buffers March onset uncertainty while groundnut adds N credit and high local demand.
key_risks: Pod fill requires adequate soil calcium/pH; humid harvest risks aflatoxin contamination.
required_local_checks: Test plot soil pH/calcium and verify dry curing racks for October-November harvest.
source_citation: CSIR-CRI Drought-Tolerant Maize & SARI Groundnut Production Guides

agronomic_rationale: High biological N-fixation (~75 kg N/ha) and Striga trap-crop benefit with growing industrial poultry-feed demand.
key_risks: 11-dekad soybean cycle is tighter than cowpea in early-ending minor rainy seasons.
required_local_checks: Confirm inoculant access and buyer contract timing before minor planting.
